workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear the current workflow? This action cannot be undone.
workflow.helpDescription: Learn how to use NanoAI Workflow system

help.threeSteps: Create your first workflow in 3 steps
help.step1: Select template or create blank canvas
help.step1Desc: Press Meta+T to open template dialog, select a preset template, or create freely on blank canvas
help.step2Desc: Drag nodes from sidebar to canvas, connect output ports to input ports to establish data flow
help.step3Desc: Set node parameters, click the 'Execute Workflow' button in the toolbar to start running
help.tip1: Node parameter changes will automatically trigger downstream nodes to re-execute
help.tip2: You can save common workflows as custom templates
help.tip3: Version history helps you revert to any historical state
help.tip4: Export workflow JSON files can be shared among team members

dragDrop.title: Node Drag & Drop
dragDrop.desc: Drag nodes from sidebar to canvas, freely combine workflows

connect.title: Smart Connection
connect.desc: Connect node output ports to downstream node input ports to establish data flow

templates.title: Template System
templates.desc: Provide preset templates, one-click load common workflow configurations

execute.title: Real-time Execution
execute.desc: Execute workflow and view running status and results of each node in real time

version.title: Version Management
version.desc: Save workflow version snapshots, revert to historical versions at any time

importExport.title: Import & Export
importExport.desc: Export workflow as JSON file, or import workflow from file

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Real-time collaborative workflow editing with team members
collaboration.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave the collaboration session?
collaboration.sessionIdPlaceholder: Enter session ID or create new session
collaboration.joinInfo: Join collaboration session and edit workflow with team members in real-time
collaboration.feature1: All operations sync in real-time to other users
collaboration.feature2: See other users' cursor positions and selections
